verdict.rationale: Linear has its own integration directory. It lists many third-party apps, including GitHub, Slack, Figma, Datadog, Salesforce, Notion, Fivetran, Airbyte and Sentry. Developers can submit apps to the directory, and admins can review and approve third-party apps before they are installed. Nothing in the evidence shows the directory is anywhere near 'thousands' of tools; the documented catalog is dozens of named integrations. missing for 10: evidence of a catalog at the scale of thousands of tools, documentation of the marketplace's browse/install experience, independent corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: To make your agent available to other workspaces, submit your agent to Linear's integration directory.
